title: garcinia novoguineensis
intro: Garcinia novoguineensis, commonly known as the Papuan garcinia, is a plant species in the family Clusiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to support overall health and well-being. The bioactive constituents of Garcinia novoguineensis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and xanthones, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
